title: Glowing toy block
svg:
<svg viewBox="0 0 100 100" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg">
  <defs>
    <radialGradient id="glow1" cx="50%" cy="50%" r="60%">
      <stop offset="0%" stop-color="#FFE066" stop-opacity="0.6"/>
      <stop offset="70%" stop-color="#FFB300" stop-opacity="0.15"/>
      <stop offset="100%" stop-color="#FFB300" stop-opacity="0"/>
    </radialGradient>
    <linearGradient id="face" x1="0" y1="0" x2="0" y2="1">
      <stop offset="0%" stop-color="#FF6B6B"/>
      <stop offset="100%" stop-color="#D63447"/>
    </linearGradient>
    <linearGradient id="side" x1="0" y1="0" x2="0" y2="1">
      <stop offset="0%" stop-color="#C62828"/>
      <stop offset="100%" stop-color="#A31515"/>
    </linearGradient>
    <linearGradient id="top" x1="0" y1="0" x2="1" y2="1">
      <stop offset="0%" stop-color="#FF9E9E"/>
      <stop offset="100%" stop-color="#FF6B6B"/>
    </linearGradient>
  </defs>

  <!-- outer glow -->
  <circle cx="50" cy="52" r="45" fill="url(#glow1)"/>

  <!-- top face of cube -->
  <polygon points="20,30 50,15 80,30 50,45" fill="url(#top)" stroke="#FFB3B3" stroke-width="1"/>

  <!-- left face -->
  <polygon points="20,30 50,45 50,80 20,65" fill="url(#face)" stroke="#FF8A8A" stroke-width="1"/>

  <!-- right face -->
  <polygon points="80,30 50,45 50,80 80,65" fill="url(#side)" stroke="#E55555" stroke-width="1"/>

  <!-- letter A on left face -->
  <g transform="translate(35,60) skewY(27)">
    <path d="M-6,8 L0,-8 L6,8 M-3.5,3 L3.5,3" fill="none" stroke="#FFE066" stroke-width="2.5" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"/>
  </g>

  <!-- star on right face -->
  <g transform="translate(65,58) skewY(-27)">
    <path d="M0,-7 L1.8,-2.2 L7,-2.2 L2.7,1.2 L4.3,6.5 L0,3.5 L-4.3,6.5 L-2.7,1.2 L-7,-2.2 L-1.8,-2.2 Z" fill="#FFE066" stroke="#FFD54F" stroke-width="0.8"/>
  </g>

  <!-- little glow sparkles around block -->
  <circle cx="15" cy="25" r="1.8" fill="#FFE066" opacity="0.8"/>
  <circle cx="85" cy="22" r="1.5" fill="#FFE066" opacity="0.7"/>
  <circle cx="88" cy="60" r="1.8" fill="#FFE066" opacity="0.8"/>
  <circle cx="12" cy="58" r="1.5" fill="#FFE066" opacity="0.7"/>
  <circle cx="50" cy="10" r="1.5" fill="#FFE066" opacity="0.9"/>
</svg>
